messages.author: fd5f619caf80837f
messages.subject: Question about scale_x_log2
parts:
Hi all,

Basically I have tried to draw a log2-scale plot by:
qplot(2^(1:10), 2^(1:10)) + scale_x_log2()

Then, I have noticed that the spaces between points in x-axis are not
consistent with the ones in the background grid (especially the minor
breaks). I.e., the spaces between points are all equal but the spaces
of minor breaks in the background grid are log-scaled. I want to make
them consistent by either moving points or updating the grid space but
don't know how I should do. I will greatly appreciate any help and
advice.

Thanks,
Jong

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Question about scale_x_log2
parts:
Hi,

In the develop version, the minor grid are aligned correctly.

If you need fix immediately, then you can specify the breaks and minor
breaks manually:

qplot(2^(1:10), 2^(1:10)) + scale_x_log2(breaks = 2^(seq(0,10,2)),
minor_breaks = 2^(0:10))


--
